# Code of conduct

Be kind when you open issues, comment, or send pull requests.

## Do

- Be respectful, even when you disagree.
- Give helpful feedback on the code, not the person.
- Help newcomers who are still learning.

## Don't

- Insult, bully or harass anyone.
- Share anyone's private notes, emails, files, API keys or other personal info, including in screenshots and logs.
- Post spam or anything not related to Personal AI OS.

## If something goes wrong

Contact the repo owner, [@ians0316](https://github.com/ians0316). Comments or people that break these rules may be removed from the project.
